# GTZ-BCH-REAL-HULL — bounded source statement

This is a project paraphrase, not the publication.

Source: Ben Green, Terence Tao and Tamar Ziegler, An inverse theorem for the Gowers U^{s+1}[N]-norm, Annals of Mathematics 176 (2012), 1231–1372. Final publisher PDF SHA256 cd320f5c1217df9bb41395e847ae2a924e70521021ca1b01c7abc20550123be1. Locator: Section 3, pp.1242–1243.

**statement**: A connected simply connected nilpotent Lie group has global exponential and logarithm coordinates and finite BCH identities. The real hull generated by A has Lie algebra generated by log A. For finite A the abstract subgroup generated by A is cocompact in its real hull, and is a lattice when discrete.

**objects**: A finite-dimensional connected simply connected nilpotent real Lie group, its Lie algebra, real powers and a finite subset A.

**hypotheses**: Nilpotency and simple connectivity; finiteness of A for the cocompactness assertion; discreteness for a lattice.

**quantifiers**: Every element and real power in the stated group; every finite generating set satisfying the stated conditions.

**parameter range**: Fixed finite nilpotency class and dimension.

**uniformity**: Exact coordinate and subgroup statements; no uniform quantitative lattice bound over changing rational structures.

**constants**: BCH has finitely many universal rational coefficients at fixed nilpotency class.

**normalizations**: g^t=exp(t log g); real generation and abstract integer-word generation are distinguished.

**exceptional cases**: Real hull need not be discrete; discreteness is an additional premise for a lattice.

**limit order**: Construct the Lie algebra and real hull; prove the discrete lattice premise in the actual application.

**Application boundary**: This does not itself prove that every rational Lie subalgebra has cocompact intersection with a given lattice. The separate GT12 A.10 bridge and local rational-geometry proofs retain that obligation.
